hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | tr '\134' '/' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.py|src/*.py) ruff check "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | tr '\134' '/' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.env|*.env.*|*/credentials/*|credentials/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: .env and credentials/ files must not be edited via Edit/Write"}}' ;; esac; }
